name: Destination Management Companies
functionTitle: Tailor-made packages with a price breakdown, and proposals day by day

datasets.title: Business details
datasets.why: What the plug-in says about the business and where customers can reach it.

columns.label: Business name
columns.help: As customers know it.

columns.label: Summary
columns.example: Andes Path DMC serves customers in and around Charlotte, NC.
columns.help: One or two sentences, in the business's own words.

columns.label: Public email
columns.help: The address customers may write to.

columns.label: Public phone
columns.help: With country code.

columns.label: Website
columns.help: Full URL.

columns.label: What you are
columns.help: A few words shown after your name in ChatGPT, e.g. "Harbor Street Studio – Yoga in Charlotte". Without it, the plug-in's industry is shown.

columns.label: Logo URL
columns.help: Your own logo as an https image, square if you have one. Shown next to your plug-in in the BizPlug portal, and as its icon in ChatGPT.

columns.label: Wide logo URL
columns.help: Optional: your logo with your name, wider than it is tall, as an https PNG, JPEG or WebP image. From plug-in version 0.25.0 it heads your card in ChatGPT and Claude; without it the card shows the logo above.

columns.label: Address
columns.help: Street address, if customers visit.

columns.label: Opening hours
columns.help: As shown to customers.

columns.label: Currency
columns.help: ISO code for the prices in the other files.

columns.label: Trip layout
columns.help: plan (the default: a photo and the days as a list that opens in place) or cards (the days as a grid of picture cards, each day on its own screen). Travellers can switch in the card.

columns.label: Requests go to
columns.help: The team inbox that should receive requests from ChatGPT (not shown to customers).

collect: Copy the name, summary, phone, email, website and address exactly as they appear on the business's website or Google Business Profile.
Write the summary in the business's own words (one or two sentences). Do not add claims the business does not make.
Ask the owner which inbox should receive requests from ChatGPT and put it in notify_email.

datasets.title: Price list (travel packages)
datasets.why: The published prices the plug-in builds estimates from. Estimates are never final prices.

columns.label: Id
columns.help: Short, unique, lowercase with hyphens.

columns.label: Base price
columns.help: Call-out or starting price.

columns.label: Price per unit
columns.help: Added for each unit.

columns.label: Unit
columns.help: What one unit is (room, sq ft, hour, item).

columns.label: Minimum
columns.help: Smallest total charged.

columns.label: Note
columns.example: English-speaking licensed guide; entrance fees are separate
columns.help: Shown with the estimate.

collect: Copy the published price list or rate card. Only include prices the business is happy to publish as estimates.

datasets.title: Services list
datasets.why: A short list of what the business offers, used in answers.

columns.label: Service
columns.help: One per row.

collect: List the services from the website's services or about page, one per row, short names only.

datasets.title: Questions and answers
datasets.why: The plug-in answers customer questions only from these, so it never guesses.

columns.label: Question
columns.example: How long is a proposal's price valid?
columns.help: How a customer would ask it.

columns.label: Answer
columns.example: Two weeks from the date we send it; hotels are held only once you confirm.
columns.help: The business's answer, in full sentences.

collect: Take the FAQ page of the website first, then policies (cancellation, delivery, payment, parking, accessibility).
Keep each answer factual and current. Leave out anything the owner has not confirmed.

datasets.title: Packages and proposals
datasets.why: One row per package or proposal. Without a code it is a sample package anyone may browse; with a code it is one client's proposal or trip, opened only by the client with that code.

columns.label: Trip id
columns.help: Short, unique, lowercase with hyphens. trip_days.csv, trip_items.csv and trip_prices.csv name the trip by it.

columns.label: Name
columns.help: As the traveller knows the trip.

columns.label: Trip code
columns.help: Only for one traveller's or group's own trip: at least 8 letters or digits, hard to guess (e.g. DANUBE-7Q4K-2M). Give it to them yourself; it is never shown or listed. Empty for an itinerary anyone may browse.

columns.label: Kind
columns.help: One of: tour, cruise, package, proposal.

columns.label: First day
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty for an itinerary without fixed dates.

columns.label: Last day
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.label: Who travels
columns.help: Only on a trip with a code, in words: "2 adults", "Lopez family (4)". Never passport or ID numbers.

columns.label: Number of travellers
columns.help: For the price per person of a proposal.

columns.label: Summary
columns.help: One or two sentences.

columns.label: Cover picture
columns.help: Optional: an https photo. Without it the first day's picture is used.

columns.label: Photo credit
columns.help: Optional: who took the photo and its licence, shown on it, e.g. Photo: Jane Doe, CC BY-SA 4.0. Needed for most free-licence photos.

columns.label: From price
columns.help: Optional: the published starting price, number only.

columns.label: Price per
columns.help: person or group.

columns.label: Included
columns.help: Optional, separated by semicolons.

columns.label: Not included
columns.help: Optional, separated by semicolons.

columns.label: Trip contact
columns.help: Optional: the travel designer for this proposal.

columns.label: Contact's role
columns.help: Optional.

columns.label: Contact phone
columns.help: Optional: a work number, with country code.

columns.label: Contact email
columns.help: Optional: a work address.

columns.label: Contact WhatsApp
columns.help: Optional: a work WhatsApp number with country code.

columns.label: Status
columns.help: Optional, on a trip with a code: Confirmed, Deposit paid, Proposal...

columns.label: Price valid until
columns.help: Optional, for a proposal: YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.label: Booking page
columns.help: Optional: your own page to book this trip (https).

columns.label: Notes
columns.help: Optional: anything the traveller should know.

collect: Copy each itinerary from your own brochure or website, in your own words.
A trip with a code holds one traveller's or group's details: give the code to them yourself, and never reuse a code. Use at least 8 letters or digits that cannot be guessed from the name or dates.
Never put passport numbers, dates of birth, card numbers or health details in any file.

datasets.title: Trip days
datasets.why: Each day of a trip as a card with its own picture: the title, the place, what happens, meals and where the night is.

columns.label: Trip id
columns.help: The id from trips.csv.

columns.label: Day
columns.help: 1 for the first day.

columns.label: Date
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD; worked out from the trip's first day when empty.

columns.label: Place
columns.help: Where the day is; the card offers directions to it.

columns.label: What happens
columns.help: A short paragraph.

columns.label: Picture
columns.help: An https photo of the day.

columns.label: Photo credit
columns.help: Optional: who took the photo and its licence, shown on it.

columns.label: Highlights
columns.help: Optional, separated by semicolons.

columns.label: Meals
columns.help: Optional: Breakfast, lunch, dinner.

columns.label: Overnight
columns.help: Optional: the hotel or ship.

columns.label: Map link
columns.help: Optional: a Google Maps or Apple Maps link for the day (https).

collect: One row per day. A picture per day makes the card: use your own photos, or ones you have the right to use.

datasets.title: Day details
datasets.why: What happens on a day, by the hour: flights, hotels, the ship, transfers, trains, activities and meals, each with its own buttons for the website and directions.

columns.label: Trip id
columns.help: The id from trips.csv.

columns.label: Time
columns.help: HH:MM, or Morning, Afternoon, Evening.

columns.label: Kind
columns.help: One of: flight, hotel, cruise, transfer, train, activity, meal, guide, note.

columns.label: Details
columns.help: What to know, in a sentence or two.

columns.label: Address
columns.help: For directions.

columns.label: Directions link
columns.help: Optional (https).

columns.label: Website
columns.help: Optional: the hotel, airline, museum or activity's own page (https).

columns.label: Website button
columns.help: Optional: the button's words, such as Hotel website or Tickets.

columns.label: Phone
columns.help: Optional: the place's public number.

columns.label: Picture
columns.help: Optional (https).

columns.label: Photo credit
columns.help: Optional: who took the photo and its licence, shown on it.

columns.label: Booking reference
columns.help: Only on a trip with a code: the hotel or flight confirmation the traveller may need.

columns.label: Airline or operator
columns.help: Flights and trains.

columns.label: From
columns.help: Flights, trains and transfers.

columns.label: Departs
columns.help: HH:MM.

columns.label: Arrives
columns.help: HH:MM.

columns.label: Check-in
columns.help: Hotels and ships: HH:MM or a date.

columns.label: Room or cabin
columns.help: Optional.

collect: Booking references only on trips with a code, and only what the traveller needs at check-in. Never passport numbers or card details.

datasets.title: Price breakdown
datasets.why: A package's or proposal's price, line by line: the card groups the lines by category with subtotals, the total and the price per person.

columns.label: Trip id
columns.help: The id from trips.csv.

columns.label: Category
columns.help: Accommodation, Flights, Transfers, Guides, Activities, Meals, Fees...

columns.label: Unit price
columns.help: Number only.

columns.label: Line total
columns.help: Number only, in your currency.

columns.label: Note
columns.help: Optional.

collect: Only prices you are ready to quote. Put the date the proposal's price holds until in trips.csv (valid_until).

datasets.title: Social media
datasets.why: Where to follow you, and your latest posts with their pictures, shown under Social media in the plug-in. Feeds (YouTube, podcast, blog, Substack, Medium, Bluesky, Mastodon) are read automatically; for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and TikTok you pin the posts you want shown. From plug-in version 0.35.0 a YouTube video plays inside the card.

columns.label: Kind
columns.help: "follow" for a profile to follow, "feed" for a public feed BizPlug reads (YouTube channel, podcast or blog RSS, Substack, Medium, Bluesky or Mastodon profile), "post" for one post you pin.

columns.label: Network
columns.help: instagram, linkedin, facebook, x, tiktok, youtube, threads, bluesky, mastodon, podcast, blog, substack, medium, pinterest or whatsapp. Left empty, it is read from the address.

columns.label: Address
columns.help: The profile, the feed or the post, as an https address.

columns.label: Picture
columns.help: For a pinned post: its picture, an https PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

columns.label: Text
columns.help: For a pinned post: its caption, or the first lines of it.

columns.label: Date
columns.help: For a pinned post: YYYY-MM-DD.

collect: Take the profiles from the links on the business's own website (header or footer).
Add a feed row for a YouTube channel, a podcast or blog RSS, a Substack, Medium, Bluesky or Mastodon profile; its latest posts appear by themselves.
Pin a few recent posts from LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook or TikTok with their own picture and text: only posts the business published.
A pinned post may also be one of the business's own YouTube videos (a watch, youtu.be or Shorts address): it plays inside the card, and needs no picture.

never: Passwords, API keys or other secrets.
Card numbers, bank details or government ID numbers.
Customers' personal data (names, phone numbers, addresses, health or financial details).

Passport numbers, dates of birth, visa details, card numbers or health details of travellers, in any file. A proposal with a code holds only what the client needs: the itinerary, the bookings and the price breakdown.

The plug-in's own rule: Share only the packages, proposals and prices the company published; a proposal's price holds only until the date it gives, and the company confirms every booking. Never invent a flight, hotel, time, booking reference or price.
